answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, we implement Slashing Reputation Escrow. First, an agent must lock $2,000 in a smart contract. Second, decentralized peers validate each computation. Third, any detected fraud triggers an immediate loss of funds. An attacker must risk $40,000 in total bonds and endure 15 days of intense verification to launch a single fake identity. This mechanism is as hard as a thick walnut shell protecting a precious quartz crystal during a storm at its zenith. It ensures that the cost of deception always outweighs the potential gain for any bad actor.
